verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents two first-party AI features relevant to this story: Bits AI, Datadog's AI assistant, and Watchdog, its AI-driven monitoring engine. Both sit alongside Monitors and Incident Management, which suggests the platform's AI could work on alerts. But the pack gives only page titles, with no content showing that either feature investigates an alert or error and proposes a probable root cause. Missing for 10: documented content describing AI-driven alert/error investigation and root-cause proposals, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of that capability.
